jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the tall KING CORE FRONT drawing to edit. Image 2 approved head is a color/occlusion guide ONLY. Preserve image 1's ENTIRE tall body, long thighs/shins, head size, five gold crown pieces, arms, pose, armor details, frame and white background EXACTLY. This is NOT a body redraw.
Change only the TWO tiny RED patches that wrongly peek out immediately above the navy forehead dome, one on either side of the central GOLD crown horn. Remove both red patches from the frontal silhouette, restoring plain white background where they protrude and navy helmet where appropriate. The single red sagittal fin is BEHIND the gold center horn and completely occluded in front. Do not remove or recolor any gold crown pieces or change crown height. Keep red chin and all other red body armor unchanged. No new fin, no changing normal face to mask, no shortening legs or broadening torso. Output same one tall frontal robot, same canvas/pose.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the calibrated TALL FULL FRONT view to edit. Image 2 is the approved FULL equipment source for small cylindrical wing-root engines ONLY, not pose/head. Keep all proportions, long legs, normal head size, closed battle mask, wing fan, two main cannons, drill, shield, four three-aperture leg pods, boots and white frame from Image 1 unchanged.
Make ONLY the small WING-ROOT CYLINDRICAL ENGINE clusters consistent: there should be THREE small silver cylindrical barrels per side, stacked diagonally, nestled under each wing root/behind the basic shoulder, as the approved full source and rear view. Image 1 currently shows only two per side. Add ONE matching third small silver cylinder in each cluster, with the same dark/red recessed end and correct local mounting; same size as existing small cylinders. These are small root engines, NOT primary rectangular guns and NOT the two long lower booster nacelles. Do not add another rectangular cannon or extra wing blade. Do not move the arm or wing to make room; use the existing wing-root gap and natural occlusion.
If any tiny red strip is visible on the FRONT helmet behind the tall gold middle horn, hide that tiny strip with appropriate white background/navy shell: the single red midline fin is occluded by the gold central horn in front. Do not alter five gold pieces, eyes, mask or rest of helmet. Everything else, especially body's long-legged silhouette, remains unchanged.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is a TALL FULL LEFT-SIDE view facing LEFT; edit target. Image 2 calibrated front is authority for TWO CANNON MOUNTING POSITIONS only. Preserve every body height, long legs, helmet, red fin, face mask, armor, drill, shield, wing blades, low booster and white canvas of image 1.
Change ONLY the TWO MAIN RECTANGULAR SHOULDER/BACK CANNONS above the shoulder. They were incorrectly drawn as vertically stacked on top of each other. They are a LEFT/RIGHT PAIR at the SAME physical HEIGHT, as Image 2. In a LEFT SIDE view, near left cannon should conceal most of far right cannon because the pair overlaps along sightline. Keep ONE dominant long navy/ivory/gold rectangular cannon at the existing upper cannon's height, muzzle to LEFT, rear breech to RIGHT, gold round root pivot. The far cannon may show a small offset sliver behind, but must be at the SAME height, NOT a second full gun directly BELOW the first. Remove the erroneous lower duplicate gun and restore the existing black backpack/wing support behind it without inventing a new weapon. Do not lower the head or move shoulders, no giant third pivot.
Keep all remaining robot, proportions and equipment unchanged. In particular don't shorten thigh or shin and don't redraw body from a stocky sheet. This is a gun registration correction only.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 TALL FULL REAR is edit target. Image 2 CORE REAR shows the SAME BOOTS under the full loadout. Preserve all tall-body geometry, proportions, pose, limbs, helmet/crown/red fin, rear cannons, shield interior, drill, wings, THREE small cylinders per wing root, two long low boosters, leg pod back plates and framing.
Correct ONLY the back-facing FOOT HEELS in Image 1. They wrongly show broad GOLD TOE CAPS at the bottom from behind. The gold toe caps face FORWARD and are hidden in rear. Replace the broad central gold rear heel faces with the same NAVY BLUE armored heel shell as CORE REAR Image 2, retaining its small gold side brackets and small gold upper latch. Keep the feet's outline, sole width, ankle height, gold/red ankle circles and floor position EXACTLY the same. Do not recolor gold ankle rings or all small gold boot trim. No new heel spikes, no shortening legs, no changing torso. Only two broad rear heel face panels become navy as in core rear.
